title: Recursive Sum to N
description: Read an integer n and print the sum 1 + 2 + ... + n, computed with a RECURSIVE function: the sum to 1 is 1, otherwise it is n plus the sum to n - 1. This is a targeted remedial probe for C8-M01 (missing-base-or-progress): without the n == 1 base case the recursion never stops, so the smallest boundary (n = 1) distinguishes base-case reasoning from endless-decomposition reasoning. Like every EvidencePack, a failure here is observed evidence that can help diagnosis, never a deterministic detection on its own.
output_format: A single integer: the sum 1 + 2 + ... + n.
